Our Services

Complete Exterior Cleaning, Done Properly

Six specialist services covering every part of your property's exterior — delivered with professional equipment, careful technique and a spotless finish.

Most Popular

Window Cleaning

Streak-free window cleaning for homes and businesses — glass, frames and sills left gleaming, inside the reach of every storey.

Protect Your Home

Gutter Emptying

Leaves, moss and debris cleared from gutters and downpipes so rainwater flows freely — helping prevent leaks, damp and costly damage.

Roofline Refresh

Gutter, Fascia & Soffit Cleaning

Green staining, grime and weathering washed away from your roofline, restoring the crisp white finish that frames your home.

Restore & Protect

Cladding Cleaning

Algae, traffic film and built-up dirt gently removed from cladding panels — bringing back the colour and protecting the surface beneath.

Inside & Out

Conservatory Cleaning

Roof panels, frames and glass cleaned inside and out, removing algae and grime so the light floods back into your favourite room.

Garden Finish

Artificial Grass Cleaning

Debris, moss and odours lifted from artificial lawns, with the pile brushed back up for that fresh, just-laid look all year round.

Why Choose ALP

Exterior Cleaning You Can Rely On

Your property deserves more than a quick rinse. We combine professional equipment, proven methods and genuine pride in the finish — every single visit.

Professional Service

Trained, uniformed cleaners using professional-grade equipment and methods suited to each surface — no shortcuts, no guesswork.

Attention to Detail

Frames, sills, seals and edges are finished by hand where it matters. We check our work before we leave — the details are the difference.

Reliable & Friendly Team

We turn up when we say we will, keep you informed, and treat your home with respect — the kind of service neighbours recommend.

Quality Results

A visibly brighter property after every visit — sparkling glass, clear gutters and a roofline that looks freshly painted, not just washed.

About Us

Keeping Your Property Clean, Fresh & Beautiful

ALP Cleaning Services is a UK exterior cleaning company built on a simple idea: your property should look as good on the outside as it feels on the inside. We help homeowners, landlords and businesses keep their buildings looking their best, all year round.

From regular window cleaning rounds to one-off deep cleans of gutters, fascias, cladding and conservatories, every job is carried out carefully, tidily and to a standard we'd be proud to put our name to.

  • One trusted team for your whole exterior
  • Regular rounds and one-off cleans available
  • Careful around your home, garden and vehicles
  • Clear quotes agreed before any work begins
